About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented IT Operations Intern to join Tencent’s IT team in the PA office, United States. You will work closely with our IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Service Support teams to support daily IT operations, project delivery, data analysis, coordination, and continuous improvement initiatives.
This role is suitable for someone with an IT background who is interested in enterprise IT operations, service management, project execution, operational planning, and cross-team collaboration. You will gain hands-on experience in real business scenarios and support the team in improving IT service quality, delivery efficiency, and operational visibility.

• Support day-to-day IT operations, including issue follow-up, service tracking, operational reporting, and documentation.

• Assist in coordinating IT projects and operational initiatives, including task tracking, meeting notes, progress updates, risk follow-up, and stakeholder communication.

• Work with IT engineers and operations teams to support project delivery, ensuring actions are clearly assigned, followed up, and closed on time.

• Collect, organize, and analyze IT operational data to identify trends, issues, risks, and improvement opportunities.

• Prepare dashboards, reports, trackers, and management summaries to improve visibility of IT operations and project progress.

• Support the planning and coordination of team activities, operational reviews, training sessions, workshops, and cross-team meetings.

• Help maintain internal knowledge bases, process documents, service guides, and project-related materials.

• Communicate with internal users and stakeholders to understand requests, collect feedback, clarify requirements, and support issue resolution.

• Support complex and multi-threaded tasks that require coordination across different teams, systems, or regions.

• Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, including workflow optimization, better use of existing tools, and light automation where applicable.

Who We Look For

• You are a Bachelor’s or Master’s student in Information Systems, Computer Science, IT Management, Engineering, Business Analytics, Project Management, or a related discipline.

• You have a basic understanding of IT operations, IT service management, infrastructure, workplace technology, or enterprise IT support.

• You have strong organizational skills and are able to manage multiple tasks, follow up on details, and drive items to closure.

• You have experience or strong interest in project coordination, project management, operational planning, or service delivery.

• You are comfortable working with data and have experience using Excel or similar tools for data analysis, reporting, and tracking.

• Experience with dashboards or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or similar platforms is a plus.

• Basic knowledge of automation tools, scripting, workflow tools, or AI productivity tools is a plus, but not mandatory.

• You are a quick learner, detail-oriented, flexible, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

• You enjoy communicating with users and stakeholders, understanding their needs, and helping solve practical problems.

• You are curious, willing to explore new topics, and comfortable handling complex or ambiguous tasks.

• You are available for a minimum of 6 months and a maximum of 12 months.

• You can commit to working from Tencent’s PA office in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous internship or project experience in IT Operations, IT Support, PMO, Service Management, Data Analysis, or Business Operations.

• Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Power BI, Excel, or other collaboration and reporting platforms.

• Experience preparing reports, dashboards, meeting materials, project trackers, or operational review documents.

• Interest in global IT operations, service governance, project delivery, and continuous improvement.

Location State(s)

US-Washington-Bellevue

The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $28.27 to $60.00 per hour. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
This position will be eligible for 1 hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked and up to 13 paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, full-time interns are also eligible to enroll in the Company-sponsored medical plan.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and analytics and eager to drive significant business impact? Procter & Gamble is looking for interns interested in various roles within the data and analytics domain, including Data Engineers, Data Asset Managers, and AI Engineers. You will have the opportunity to apply innovative technologies to solve complex business problems and contribute to data-driven decision-making.

The work you will be doing could range from analyzing large datasets to providing actionable insights, managing data assets to ensure data quality and accessibility, to engineering robust data pipelines that feed analytical models and support business operations. Regardless of the specific role, as a Data, Analytics, & AI Engineering intern, you will be someone who leverages data to solve business problems.

Example Responsibilities by Role Type:

- Data Engineer: Design, build, and maintain cloud-based data and analytics platforms and data pipelines that acquire, cleanse, transform, and publish data from a wide range of sources. Develop large, complex datasets that support both functional and non-functional business requirements, while partnering with data asset managers, architects, and development leads to deliver high-quality, fit-for-purpose data solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards. Contribute to and apply coding standards and best practices to create efficient, scalable, and reusable services and components. Design and implement process improvements that enhance operational efficiency, data quality, and overall platform performance.

- AI Engineer: Drive proof-of-concept development and experimental initiatives to evaluate emerging technologies, advanced models, and innovative solutions. Engineer high-quality, standards-compliant, and rigorously tested software while contributing reusable code, frameworks, and tools to shared repositories, enterprise libraries, and open-source projects in alignment with P&G IT policies. Design, develop, and optimize data models, feature engineering capabilities, data quality assurance processes, ETL/ELT pipelines, and scalable distributed computing architectures. Deploy, monitor, and enhance algorithmic solutions across cloud platforms, leveraging cloud-native services to ensure reliability, scalability, efficiency, and business impact.

- Data Asset Manager: Leading data governance activities aligned with the organization’s data strategy within assigned areas of accountability. Serve as trusted advisors to business partners, influencing strategic decisions and driving the continuous improvement of data governance practices. Oversees critical data management functions such as data quality, data operations, storage, reference and master data, data standards, security, vendor governance, and metadata management to ensure data is accurate, secure, accessible, and fit for business use.

As an intern, you will experience a subset of the above responsibilities

Job Qualifications

- You must be available during the summer of 2027 for a 12 week internship from mid/late May through early August.

- In the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math, Statistics, Analytics or like degrees.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in programming languages such as Python, SQL, R, or similar (Experience in a specific language is not required; you will be expected to learn new languages).

- Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and understanding of data management practices.

- Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical colleagues effectively.

Preferred:

- A history of solving complex problems with innovative solutions.

- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.

- Understanding of data governance and data quality best practices.

- Relevant experience or coursework in data analysis, data management, or related fields.

​

- Identify potential opportunities of improvement, including areas which can be challenging to achieve during the internship period.

About Ingredion:

Join Ingredion, where innovation impacts lives worldwide! Without even realizing it, you’ve experienced our work in your favorite chocolate, your pet’s food, the paper you write on, and your everyday snacks. As a global powerhouse across more than 60 industries, we harness the potential of natural ingredients to transform lives. Whether you’re just starting your career or bringing years of experience, there's a place for you here to make a real difference. Be part of our team that values a wide range of perspectives and is committed to shaping a better world with every product we create.

Location: Bridgewater, NJ

Workplace type: Hybrid (3 days/week on-site)

We have an exciting opportunity for an ambitious student to join our R&D team for summer 2027! As the Digital Innovation Intern, you will help accelerate the adoption of predictive formulation and digital innovation capabilities across our organization. Working closely with formulation scientists and digital innovation leaders, you will explore leading academic approaches and develop practical digital tools for automated data capture, data quality assessment, feature extraction, predictive modeling, and virtual experimentation. Your work may include converting food or microscopy images into quantitative measurements, creating machine-learning descriptors from molecular structures, developing AI-powered workflows, and applying large language models (LLM) and agentic approaches to scientific data analysis and knowledge extraction!

What you will do:

- Review academic literature, open-source methods, and emerging technologies relevant to predictive formulation, machine learning, artificial intelligence, agentic systems, automated data capture, image analysis, and computational chemistry.
- Develop digital tools that automate data capture, data quality assessment, feature extraction, data preparation, and model development workflows.
- Build predictive models and create virtual experiment tools that allow scientists to explore formulation space and visualize predicted results.
- Explore and implement AI, LLM and agentic approaches to support scientific knowledge extraction, data interpretation, experiment planning, and workflow automation.
- Design reusable code base and create clear technical documentation, user guides, and examples that support future predictive modeling projects.
- Summarize progress, communicate results to project partners, and present recommendations and a final demonstration at the completion of the internship.

What you will bring:

- Progress towards a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Food Science, Chemical engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Chemistry or a related field.
- Experience using Python or other data descriptive languages for data analysis, model development, workflow automation, or scientific research.
- Familiarity with one or more of the following areas are preferred.

- Machine learning and predictive modeling
- Artificial Intelligence, LLMs or agentic approaches
- Image analysis and computer vision
- Computational chemistry
- Data visualization and dashboard development
- Design of experiments and statistical analysis

- Ability to organize, analyze, and interpret scientific data and communicate technical results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Reliable transportation required to get to and from facility each work day.

Who you are:

- Curious and passionate to apply data science and digital technologies to solve scientific challenges.
- Collaborative and comfortable working with people from different technical backgrounds.
- A practical problem-solver who takes initiative and delivers results.

To be eligible for consideration, candidates must:

- Currently possess unrestricted authorization to work in the United States. Ingredion does not intend to sponsor work visas with respect to this position or to provide this position as OPT or CPT.
- Be a currently enrolled student in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program. If currently enrolled in an undergrad status, must have completed at least two years of coursework with status as a sophomore, junior or non-graduating senior.
- If you have completed your degree, please consider other opportunities with Ingredion, posted at ww.ingredion.com/careers.

Why Join Ingredion?

Discover why Ingredion is the ideal place to advance your career with our exception rewards and benefits package designed to help you thrive. Create the future with us and enjoy:

- Total Rewards Package – competitive hourly salary based on your degree program. Housing stipends offered to students relocating 51+ miles from the Ingredion work location
- Internship Program Events & Activities – programming catered toward career exploration, networking, and professional development - including the annual Capstone Summit at Ingredion HQ in Westchester, IL
- Intern Coaching Program – pairing with a mentor to coach development and integration in Ingredion’s culture
- Involvement in Ingredion’s Business Resource Groups – the conscience of the organization and an integral part to Ingredion’s Inclusion & Belonging strategy
- Employee Recognition Program – a culture of real-time appreciation, with personalized recognition rewards globally
- Employee Discount Program – provides exclusive discounts on everyday products, services, and travel

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. Ingredion seeks to provide a work environment that is free from harassment and discrimination. We will not tolerate any form of discrimination based on race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, handicap or disability—mental or physical—marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability resulting from military service, or any other classification protected by law (“protected classifications”). We are committed to establishing and maintaining a work environment where everyone is treated with dignity and respect.

Ingredion provides accommodations to job applicants with disabilities throughout the hiring process. If a job applicant requires an accommodation during the application process or through the selection process, we will work with the applicant to meet the job applicant's accommodation needs.

Ingredion uses AI-enabled tools to support parts of the recruitment process, including resume screening and interview scheduling. These tools help match candidate skills to job requirements and streamline communication. All AI-assisted decisions are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable laws. By applying, you acknowledge that AI may be used to support your application journey.

Relocation Available:

No

Final base salary will be determined based on several factors which may include but are not limited to responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data and applicable bargaining agreement (if any).

Full-time roles are eligible for our comprehensive benefits package which includes medical, dental and vision coverage as well as a 401(k) plan with a competitive company match .

University - 2027 Summer Games Systems Engineer Intern - Rome, NY

The Opportunity:

The Summer Games is an innovative internship program that attracts some of the nation’s best and brightest students. The goal is to develop a breakthrough idea or solution for one of our customer's most pressing, complex, and multidimensional problems while developing valuable technical skills. This competitive and collaborative program attracts thousands of applicants each year. Simulating a real-world startup accelerator environment, the interns are divided into teams, each working on a different challenge project. Throughout the Games, interns receive mentorship from senior leaders, solve problems using Booz Allen’s products and unique engagement models, and leverage the power of collaboration in a team environment.

The summer culminates with a final Challenge Cup competition and presentation to senior leadership. A past winner took the challenge of helping blind individuals navigate by using new technology and developing a business and market penetration plan. Teams have also helped to develop an app that gives military commanders an easy way to track real-time and open-source information about developing situations, including sudden attacks, fighting human trafficking, and even tracking the spread of a disease worldwide.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

- Experience with programming languages, including .NET, C++, JavaScript, Java, or Python, in a professional, academic, or internship work environment

- Knowledge of software development best practices

- Ability to learn new languages and frameworks

The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. Identity Statement

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

The Airborne Radar Electronics Design Department at Raytheon is seeking a highly motivated Electrical Engineering Intern for Summer 2027 to support VHDL-based firmware development and hardware integration activities for advanced airborne radar systems. Depending on assignments, this role may involve supporting FPGA development, digital design verification, radar hardware integration, and system-level troubleshooting. The intern will work closely with experienced radar electronics engineers on real hardware used in airborne radar platforms.

What You Will Do:

- Assist in developing, modifying, and verifying VHDL firmware modules for radar-related FPGA subsystems
- Support simulation, testbench development, and debugging using industry-standard EDA tools
- Participate in airborne radar hardware integration, could include board-level bring-up, signal interface testing, and system validation
- Execute structured test procedures and document results thoroughly
- Troubleshoot firmware, digital interfaces, and radar hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and FPGA debugging tools
- Collaborate with engineering teams to validate system functionality and implement required design updates
- Support continuous improvement of test setups, documentation practices, and development workflows

What You Will Learn:

- Practical experience developing and validating VHDL firmware for airborne radar electronics
- Exposure to real radar hardware integration workflows and system verification
- Mentorship from engineers experienced in airborne radar design and development
- Opportunities to support meaningful radar hardware tasks during the summer program

Qualifications You Must Have:

- Must be pursuing Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering or related Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) major and actively enrolled through the completion of the internship/co-op session.
- Must have a minimum of 60 hours of credit by the start of the internship / co-op session.
- Coursework or project experience involving VHDL, Verilog, and digital logic design
- Familiarity with FPGA development environments (Vivado, Quartus, ModelSim, etc.)
- Basic knowledge of electronics, digital interfaces, and hardware test equipment
- Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work effectively in a lab-focused engineering environment

Qualifications We Prefer:

- Experience with Python, C/C++, MATLAB, or scripting languages for test automation
- Prior experience with FPGA projects, embedded systems, or digital signal processing coursework
- Hands-on familiarity with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes or logic analyzers
- Interest in radar systems or RF/digital hardware
